title: Dallas Towers canonical building-intelligence record
description: Architecture target for the registry. Populating any field requires verified information; unknown fields are omitted, never guessed. The live dataset (dallastowers-data.json) is a legacy subset of this schema; migration is additive and never changes public URLs.

building_id.description: Stable slug; equals the public URL slug. Never renamed.

alternate_names.description: Marketing / legal-condo / phase / historic names. Entity resolution: one physical condominium regime = one record; aliases live here, never as duplicate pages.

verification_status.description: unverified: entity exists, identity unconfirmed. partial: identity confirmed (name+address+district+era from a named source) but core facts (floors/units/type) incomplete — maps from legacy conf:'p'. verified: all core identity fields (name, address, city, district, year_built, floors, units, property_type) carry sources — maps from legacy conf:'v' AFTER floors/units/address gaps are closed; legacy 'v' records missing those fields downgrade to partial at migration. verified_current: verified AND every provenanced core field re-checked within 12 months. Name+address+coordinates alone NEVER exceed unverified.

rights_class.description: COPYRIGHT GUARD: licensed_official requires a license record. independent_schematic must be drawn from verified measurements, labeled 'schematic — not to scale' unless truly to scale, and must not trace copyrighted artwork. metadata_only publishes structured facts with no image. unknown never renders an image. Never invent dimensions.

image.description: Path under site/img/. Absent for metadata_only/unknown.

view_lines.description: No 'protected view' claims without legal/planning evidence. Prefer 'faces southeast toward downtown' over 'permanent unobstructed skyline view'.

protected_claim_evidence.description: Required before any 'protected'/'permanent' wording appears publicly.

observations.description: APPEND-ONLY history. Never overwrite a prior observation; history begins at first verified observation — no reconstructed backfill unless an archived official source is retained as provenance. Dues are never assumed uniform: unit_basis captures per-unit/size/allocation variation.

unit_basis.description: e.g. 'per sqft', 'flat per unit', 'allocation % — varies by unit', with the specific basis

rules.description: Every consequential rule needs source + dates. If unknown: omit (renders as 'Not yet verified'). NEVER infer rules from another building.

documents.description: Inventory of what exists and what a buyer should request — NOT a channel for restricted materials. public_private gates rendering; never publish private/confidential documents.

public_record.description: STRICT VALUE SEMANTICS — Texas non-disclosure. Only these typed fields may carry dollar values; generic 'price'/'price_per_sqft' fields are forbidden by the validator.

assessed_value.description: Certified-roll value. Public label MUST be 'assessed value' / 'appraisal-district value' / 'certified-roll value' — never 'sale price', 'sold for', 'market sale price'.

recorded_transfers.description: Deed instruments: dates and instrument types only. A transfer count is NEVER represented as a verified arms-length sales count; TX deeds carry no prices.

homestead_exemption_share.description: PROXY. Public wording: 'X% of matched units carried a homestead exemption in the certified roll, a rough proxy for owner occupancy.' Never 'X% owner occupied'.

listing_price.description: Only from a live, cited listing. Distinct type; never mixed with assessed fields.

verified_sale_price.description: Only from a documented transaction disclosure (e.g. party-provided closing statement) with retained provenance. TX public records can never populate this.

media.description: No stock photography presented as the actual tower. Every asset carries rights.

minimum_file_threshold.description: THIN-BUILDING GUARD for FUTURE publication (existing indexed pages are exempt — recommendations only). A new building page may only be published/indexed when: verification_status >= partial, AND at least 2 of {units, floors, year_built} are provenanced, AND at least 1 of {county public_record data, an hoa observation, a provenanced rule, a verified floor_plan} exists, AND district context prose is specific to the building. Name+address+coordinates alone never publish.

provenanced.description: Field-level provenance envelope for mutable/consequential claims. Immutable obvious facts (city, district label) do not need it.
